Description
Introducing the 1/2 oz PAMP Fortuna Gold Minted Bar, a masterpiece from the world-renowned PAMP (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux). As a leading independent refiner of precious metals, PAMP has set the gold standard for excellence and authenticity since 1979. This beautiful gold bar features the iconic Lady Fortuna™ design, symbolizing prosperity and trust.
Product Highlights:
Metal: 999.9 Fine Gold
Weight: 0.5 Ounce (15.55g)
Dimensions: 17.1 mm x 29.5 mm x 1.61 mm
Design: Lady Fortuna™ with proof-like finish
Packaging: Individually registered and secured in protective CertiPAMP™ packaging
Assurance: Includes an integrated official Assay Certificate for guaranteed purity and weight
Accreditation: Certified by the Swiss Federal Bureau – VERISCAN™ Technology: Instant authentication via iOS mobile device for added security
Why Choose PAMP Gold Bars?
Trusted Excellence: Introduced in 1979, the Lady Fortuna™ design is globally recognized as a hallmark of PAMP quality and integrity.
Superior Craftsmanship: Each bar features the Roman goddess of prosperity, complete with mythical attributes like sheaves of wheat, poppies, the horn of plenty, precious coins, and the wheel of fortune.
Investment-Grade: Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs and defined as Good Delivery by major international markets including the Swiss National Bank and London Bullion Market Association.
Secure Packaging: Each gold bar is individually controlled, registered, and sealed in CertiPAMP™ packaging with a certificate to verify authenticity and weight.
Responsible Sourcing: As part of the Public-Private Alliance for Responsible Minerals Trade, PAMP ensures ethical sourcing of precious metals.
Advanced Technology:
The VERISCAN™ app
, available on iPhone® 7 or above, offers a simple, cost-efficient way to authenticate your PAMP gold bar, reducing the risk of counterfeit products.
Enhance your investment portfolio with this highly coveted 1/2 oz PAMP Lady Fortuna gold bar. Its prestigious design and impeccable quality make it a valuable addition to any collection. Order now from Bullion Trading LLC and secure your piece of this world-renowned gold bar today!
Note: For the best scanning results, use the VERISCAN™ app to scan the QR code on the CertiPAMP™ assay card packaging.
